pages.text: Welcome to $(thing)Atomic Additions$(). This mod adds the $(thing)Atomic Material Reprocessor$() (AMR), a multiblock that fuses two atomic gases into a third one.$(br2)The goal is to produce $(thing)Tantalum$() and $(thing)Rhenium$(), then use them to multiply the shards you get from crystals in Mekanism's ore processing.
New entries unlock as you make progress. Check your advancements to see what comes next.
